Citation_Text: At the time of inspection, Respondent failed to demonstrate by either lab report or chain of custody form that all required Legionella samples were taken during Cooling Tower System operation. Legionella sample records were missing for period of 01/04/2024 to 04/09/2024, a period of over 90 days while in operation. A legionella sample would have needed to have been taken by 04/03/2024 to satisfy the 90 day requirement. Respondent's records also failed to demonstrate by either lab report or chain of custody form that Post Corrective Legionella samples were collected as required after a Legionella result of 444.44 CFU/ml (sample taken 03/03/2023, corrective action 03/22/2023) and a result of 21.30 CFU/ml. (sample taken 09/19/2023, corrective action 10/10/2023)  Legionella sample records were not provided for the required 3-7 day periodsfollowing these corrective actions. Citation_Text:
During the inspection, the respondent failed to provide either a lab report or a chain of custody form to demonstrate that all required Legionella samples were taken while the cooling tower system was in operation.

According to regulations, Legionella samples must be taken every 90 days while the system is active. Samples were recorded on 01/19/2024 and 10/15/2024; however, no additional samples were collected between these dates, resulting in a gap of over 90 days. To meet the 90-day requirement, another sample should have been taken by 04/18/2024 and 07/17/2024

The system was confirmed to be in operation during this period, based on other available records. Neither the system representative, Mr. Thomas Carvetta, nor any other building staff could provide the missing records at the time of inspection.
